svg.title: 300 Redis data nodes and a three-host Lavik capacity model
svg.desc: The Redis model has 150 primaries and 150 replicas. The Lavik candidate has one primary and two followers, each with a complete copy, plus three co-located Meta voters. Each Lavik VM has 3.84 TB of NVMe SSD. Capacity is before overhead; prices use Azure East US 2 Linux pay-as-you-go and 730 hours per month.

g.text: CAPACITY MODEL · 150 primary–replica pairs → 1 primary + 2 followers
One complete copy on each VM
